messages:
morgan: Heads-up — CI alerted a SAST finding (sql-injection) on payments service but DAST didn't flag anything. Also noticed KMS audit logs don't show key decrypts for the test-run. Anyone seen this mismatch?

jia: Which SAST rule id? can you paste the snippet and the failing file path?

morgan: rule: SAST-SQL-03. File: services/payments/adapter.go. Snippet:
```go
query := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=%s", id)
rows, err := db.Query(query)
```

arjun: That looks like a scanning heuristic — fmt.Sprintf with unescaped input. DAST misses it because the runtime path isn't hit in the staging harness. Could be false positive if we use parameterized queries elsewhere.

lex: Also KMS: which key? the test-run uses ephemeral key from dev-kms-ephemeral. Audit logs are in cloud-logs -> projects/redwood/logs/kms.googleapis.com%2Fcrypto_key_version

olivia: We recently changed RBAC on the payments CI service account — removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for the runner. That might explain missing decrypt logs.

morgan: oh — when did that change happen?

olivia: Yesterday 14:12 UTC via PR #5432 (approved). I flagged it in the change request but maybe we missed the CI scope.

jia: If CI lost cryptoKey permissions it won't be able to call KMS so no decrypt audit entries. But SAST will still run locally (scanner reads code), so mismatch is expected.

morgan: ok that explains audit log gap. For the SAST finding — I think it's actionable. It's in adapter.go line 78. How should we triage? block the PR?

arjun: Suggestion: mark as 'needs-evidence' and add the quick repro steps. If it's exploitable in production path then block. If not, create suppression with evidence attached using the scanner's suppression API: `scanner suppress --rule SAST-SQL-03 --file services/payments/adapter.go --evidence path/to/trace`.

lex: For process: we should add a checklist item for RBAC change requests to include "ci-scoped keys & audit implications". I'll add to runbook.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-0789. Tags: sast, kms, rbac. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2024-0789

olivia: I've temporarily re-granted crypto decrypt to the runner and kicked off the staging pipeline. Can someone re-run the SAST/DAST and paste logs?

morgan: re-run done. SAST still flags the line but DAST produced a negative. I attached the staging run: https://ci.redwood/runs/98765

jia: From logs: scanner v2.3.1 emits `SAST-SQL-03` on pattern match. We should confirm scope via a quick grep for `Query(` usages and test harness to find runtime inputs. I'll run a narrow integration test.

arjun: I'll draft a short postmortem template: impact, root cause (RBAC removal + scanner heuristic), action items (fix adapter to use parameterized query, add RBAC checklist, add test to staging harness), owner assignment.

lex: Also add audit-log assertion to CI smoke: verify that KMS audit entries exist for any pipeline that uses decrypt. Small snippet:
```
# pseudo
gcloud logging read "logName=projects/redwood/logs/kms.googleapis.com%2Fcrypto_key_version" --limit=5
```

olivia: I'll open an RFC to include KMS audit checks + RBAC matrix for service accounts. PR coming.

morgan: thanks all. I'll file the SAST ticket with evidence and link the incident. Assigning to @arjun for the fix and @olivia for RBAC/RFC.

sec-bot: Update: INC-2024-0789 moved to triage. Priority: P2.
